source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban data" AND (governance OR justice OR ownership OR commons OR sovereignty)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban data" AND (governance OR justice OR ownership OR commons OR sovereignty),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban data" AND ("commons" OR "governance" OR "justice" OR "ownership" OR "sovereignty"))
